questions.question: The LORD said He had known only Israel out of all the families of the earth. What did He say He would do because of that?

answers.text: Punish them for all their sins

questions.question: The Lord GOD said He does nothing without revealing His plan. Who did He say He reveals it to?
Because the people of Samaria stored up violence in their strongholds, what did the Lord GOD say was coming?

answers.text: An enemy will surround the land
A drought will dry up the land
A flood will cover the land

questions.question: When the LORD punishes Israel, what did He say will happen to the horns of the altar at Bethel?

answers.text: They will be cut off and fall to the ground
They will be covered in fresh gold again
They will be carried off to Egypt
